adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic_embed.rb`, the diff introduces `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` and passes `category: eh.try(:category_id)` to `PostCreator`. From `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, `record_for_host` can return `false` when parsing fails or no host matches, so using `try` avoids an exception but will pass `nil` as the category. The diff also shows upstream checks (`EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` and `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`) now gate embedding by `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`, so in the primary flows `eh` should exist; thus this is more of a latent fragility/implicit assumption than a currently verifiable defect in this PR.
